description: Change a Replo automation (scheduled task). Read it with get_task first: title, prompt and rrule are always replaced, so pass the current values for any the user isn't changing, and pass the current emoji too or it resets to ✨; omitting delivery keeps it. Pass scheduledAt, a future ISO time with the user's timezone offset, for the next run: without it the schedule restarts from now, which moves the time of day and leaves a one-time automation with no run. Confirm the change with the user before calling. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

delivery.description: Where each run's results go, e.g. { email: { recipients: ["me@brand.com"] } }. When the user wants results delivered, default to their own address. `{ email: { recipients: [] } }` turns email off; omitting it on update keeps the current delivery.

emoji.description: Emoji label used to visually group this task in the schedule UI.

playbookId.description: Id of the playbook this task is based on, when the user picked one; its sample email becomes the run's layout guideline.

prompt.description: The exact prompt the task should run. This must be self-contained and executable without asking the user follow-up questions. Include any reasonable assumptions needed to complete the task, and do not include instructions like 'ask the user' or 'wait for clarification'.

rrule.description: RRULE string for recurrence, such as FREQ=DAILY. Use FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1 for one-time tasks.

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time with an explicit timezone offset for the next run; the recurrence restarts from it. Must be in the future. Omit to restart the schedule from now.

title.description: Short human-readable title for the task.

name: update_task
title: Update an automation
